title: Enfla-Mend Px - 120 Caps
abstract:
# Enfla-Mend Px - 120 Caps  
- Enfla-Mend Px delivers more than DOUBLE the active compounds compared to the leading curcumin brand, at a fraction of the price.
- This formula combines three forms of turmeric- whole root, curcuminoid extract, and turmerone supercritical CO2 extract- to optimize absorption and activity.
- This synergistic botanical blend provides the highest curcumin essential oil content and turmerones per capsule in the industry.
- Turmerones balance NF-kB to effectively mediate prostaglandin activity.
- Strong preclinical evidence demonstrates that turmerones support neurogenesis, microglial modulation, and neuroprotection.
- Provides relief of minor pain due to occasional overuse, without side effects.
- Uses phosphatidylcholine from certified organic sunflower lecithin.
- View our absorption study, demonstrating equal bioavailability to a phytosome complex, performed by independent lab: [Comparison of Two Commercial Preparations of Curcumin using the Caco-2 in vitro Assay of Human Intestinal Permeability](https://restorativemedicine.org/journal/comparison-curcumin-caco-2-human-intestinal-permeability/)

### Formulation Features  
- Highest curcumin essential oil content and turmerones per cap in the industry. As tested by HPLC, contains 285 curcuminoids and 137 turmerones per two capsules.
- First to market offering phosphatidylcholine from certified organic sunflower lecithin mixed with curcuminoids and certified organic turmerones.
- The liquid formula is contained in a hard shell vegi-capsule. Ingredient separation is visible and normal.
- Black pepper enhances absorption of turmeric compounds.
- Turmerone compounds contained in turmeric root support healthy levels of monoamines supporting balanced emotional well-being.
